fields.description: Terra Heights brings one- and two-bedroom apartments to Expo Living. Four mid-rise buildings frame two landscaped courtyards, combining shared outdoor spaces with an address close to Expo City. This is a distinct release with its own building-specific layouts and payment schedule.

overview: The residential arrangement puts communal courtyards at the centre of the development. Pools, places to exercise and indoor gathering rooms serve different daily routines, while balconies extend the apartments’ living space. A courtyard-facing home and an outward-facing apartment can offer quite different surroundings; orientation should be checked on the building plan.

The masterplan places Terra Heights beside the metro corridor, with Expo Road and Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Road around the wider setting. It also identifies a Dubai Expo Mall development. That drawing describes the planned neighbourhood and does not establish that every retail or transport connection is already complete.
research.locationNote: Expo Living sits in the Expo City/Dubai South area. The developer page and launch fact sheet give different journey-time estimates, so no fixed commute is promised here. Check the actual entrance, walking route to the station and current road access for the chosen building.
research.priceNote: Emaar displays AED 1.4m. The November 2024 launch fact sheet lists one-bedroom apartments from AED 1.4m and two-bedroom apartments from AED 2.07m. These starting references do not confirm an available unit or today’s asking price.
research.paymentNote: The launch schedule totals 80% before completion and 20% at estimated completion. Later instalments reference construction progress. Several dates are historical; a current statement is needed for a new allocation or resale purchase.
research.handoverNote: The original payment document estimates March 2029. Bayut gives Q1 2029. Neither replaces the contractual completion provisions or a current construction update.

facts.label: Launch apartment mix
facts.value: 1,004 apartments: 484 one-bedroom and 520 two-bedroom homes. This describes the launch collection, not available stock.

facts.label: Building arrangement
facts.value: Four mid-rise buildings around two courtyards; the Building 3 section identifies ground plus 13 floors.

facts.label: Understanding the size table
facts.value: Totals include balconies or terraces. The examples identify individual plan variants, not all available layouts; larger terraces do not necessarily mean larger interiors.

facts.label: Plan documents
facts.value: The main floor-plan download covers Building 3. Separate Building 1, 2 and 4 documents are linked in the research sources.

unresolved: Current availability, exact unit pricing, service charges and the purchaser’s outstanding payment balance require confirmation.
Published journey-time estimates differ between the developer page and launch fact sheet; actual routes and traffic should be assessed independently.
The masterplan’s proposed mall and wider-community elements are not represented as operational facilities.
Unit numbering repeats across buildings. Match the selected apartment to its own building’s plan and signed area schedule; rounded launch bands and exact plan measurements are not interchangeable.
March 2029 is a published estimate. Current construction progress, final specifications and contractual completion terms remain subject to confirmation.
